title: Jesus Prays in the Morning
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus had helped people all day, until after the sun went down. Very early the next morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up.
He went out to a quiet place, all by Himself. There He prayed to Heavenly Father.
Even Jesus, the Son of Heavenly Father, wanted to pray. He wanted to be close to His Father.
p2: Soon Simon Peter and the others came looking for Him. “Everyone is looking for You!” they said. Jesus said, “Let us go to the other towns. I will teach there too. That is why I came.”
So Jesus went all through Galilee, teaching. You can pray like Jesus, in a quiet place. Tonight, kneel and talk to Heavenly Father.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
